body.name: R1
body.def: For \(j=(C,s)\in J\), set \(U^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}=N_{n1s}^{-1}\{\sum_l\mathbf 1[Y^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsl}<Y^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}]+\tfrac12\sum_l\mathbf 1[Y^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsl}=Y^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}]\}\), \(\bar U^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{ns}=N_{n1s}^{-1}\sum_iU^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}\), and \(S^{2,U}_{n1s}=(N_{n1s}-1)^{-1}\sum_i(U^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}-\bar U^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{ns})^2\). When \(1\le m_{n1s}<N_{n1s}\) and \(S^{2,U}_{n1s}>0\), let \(D^R_{n1s}=m_{n1s}^{-1}\sum_iZ_{n1si}U^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}-(N_{n1s}-m_{n1s})^{-1}\sum_i(1-Z_{n1si})U^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}\), \(\widehat v^R_{n1s}=S^{2,U}_{n1s}\{m_{n1s}^{-1}+(N_{n1s}-m_{n1s})^{-1}\}\), and \(R_{1j}=D^R_{n1s}/\sqrt{\widehat v^R_{n1s}}\); otherwise set \(R_{1j}=0\).
